scripts.db:seed:remote: bun -e 'const{execSync}=require("child_process");const{randomBytes,createCipheriv}=require("crypto");const{readFileSync,writeFileSync}=require("fs");const k=process.env.PAYMENT_ENCRYPTION_KEY||"secureit_payment_db_secret_key_v1_32b";const kb=Buffer.from(k.padEnd(32,"0").slice(0,32),"utf-8");function enc(t){const iv=randomBytes(12);const c=createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm",kb,iv);let e=c.update(t,"utf-8","hex");e+=c.final("hex");e+=c.getAuthTag().toString("hex");return"enc:"+iv.toString("hex")+":"+e};const now=new Date().toISOString();const sql=`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO AdminUser(id,email,passwordHash,createdAt)VALUES("admin-001","admin@secureit.com","$2b$12$uw/SYHkEWL1aVO82pPcbfut2Z7/e/aB1r5LTyw1IW8LEOWtRIwdBG","${now}");INSERT OR IGNORE INTO Plan(id,name,description,basePrice,currency,durationDays,isActive,isDefault,createdAt,updatedAat)VALUES("plan-licenca-001","Licença","Acesso completo a todas as funcionalidades do SecureIT",81.27,"USD",30,1,1,"${now}","${now}");INSERT OR IGNORE INTO PlanFeature(id,planId,name,description,price,isActive,createdAt)VALUES("pf-001","plan-licenca-001","Análise Comportamental","Análise avançada de comportamento em tempo real",0,1,"${now}");INSERT OR IGNORE INTO PlanFeature(id,planId,name,description,price,isActive,createdAt)VALUES("pf-002","plan-licenca-001","Cloud Storage","Armazenamento de gravações na cloud",0,1,"${now}");INSERT OR IGNORE INTO PlanFeature(id,planId,name,description,price,isActive,createdAt)VALUES("pf-003","plan-licenca-001","Tunnel de Acesso Remoto","Acesso remoto seguro às suas câmeras",0,1,"${now}");INSERT OR IGNORE INTO PaymentInfo(id,iban,accountName,bankName,reference,isActive,createdAt)VALUES("pi-001","${enc("PT50 0002 0000 0000 0000 0000 0")}","${enc("SecureIT Angola Lda")}","${enc("Banco Angolano de Investimentos")}","${enc("SecureIT-")}",1,"${now}");`;writeFileSync("/tmp/seed_remote.sql",sql);execSync("wrangler d1 execute secureit --remote --file /tmp/seed_remote.sql",{stdio:"inherit"})'
